title: Average Height of a Bilinear Surface
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Compute the average height of the surface z = xy over the unit square [0, 1] x [0, 1].

steps.title: Calculate Area and Double Integral
steps.mathExpression: \text{Area}(R) = 1; \quad \iint_R xy \, dA = \left(\int_0^1 x \, dx\right)\left(\int_0^1 y \, dy\right) = \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = \frac{1}{4}
steps.explanation: Evaluate the double integral over the unit square.

steps.title: Compute Average Height
steps.explanation: Divide the integral by the unit area.
